notes.title: Nominate Ninja Kidz for Steam Awards in "Better with Friends" Category
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Attention all Steam gamers and Ninja Kidz enthusiasts![/b] [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803124/11e44ec50b0d7d0e0773b0d7044a9db3ea9e4e2c.jpg[/img]

It's time to make our voices heard and shine a spotlight on the unique experience offered by "Ninja Kidz: Time Masters." We're thrilled to invite you to nominate this incredible game for the Steam Awards,  [i][b]in the "Better with Friends" category until Nov 28th.[/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287000/NINJA_KIDZ_TIME_MASTERS/

[i]"Ninja Kidz: Time Masters" is not just an exciting journey through time; it's also an exceptional cooperative experience. The ability to play with friends, adds a special touch to the gameplay, making the experience even more memorable.[/i]

If you've enjoyed sharing epic moments with friends while rescuing martial arts masters as a Ninja Kid, now is the time to show your support! Head over to the Steam Awards nomination page and highlight "Ninja Kidz: Time Masters" in the "Better with Friends" category. Your nomination can make a difference and help this outstanding game gain recognition from the Steam community. Let the voting begin!

notes.title: Ninja Kidz: Time Masters Out Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Ninja Kidz Time Masters[/b], the official action-adventure game that features YouTube stars Ninja Kidz TV, is out now worldwide in digital stores for [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/ninja-kidz-time-masters-switch/][b]Nintendo Switch[/b][/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10007611][b]PlayStation 4 and 5[/b][/url], PC via [b]Steam[/b]. The digital release for Xbox consoles will follow on 20th October. 

With over 20 million subscribers on YouTube, [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/reO3pHSE0PA]Ninja Kidz TV[/url] is one of the biggest entertainment channels in the world. [i]Ninja Kidz: Time Masters is an action-adventure video game inspired by classic beat 'em-ups. [/i]

[previewyoutube=zT0YoHZHNDs;full][/previewyoutube]

[u]The three greatest martial arts masters have been kidnapped and Dr Disaster and his henchmen have trapped them in different historical eras. The Ninja Kidz are the only ones able to cross the time vortex and use their abilities to rescue them and preserve the path of the ninja.[/u]

[b]Join the Ninja Kidz in their adventure to defeat Dr. Disaster, and bring back peace to the world.[/b] Travel through time and explore different eras by completing fun and challenging 16 levels and watch the story unfold by watching cartoon style cutscenes. Explore all the levels to get extra lives by finding Ninja coins, becoming the ultimate Ninja Kidz, and rescuing all the martial arts masters by defeating the final bosses.

[list]
[*] Choose from 4 playable characters. Each Ninja Kidz has its own special moves and techniques.
[*] Play solo or with friends in local co-op with up to 4 players.
[*] Enjoy the colourful cartoon-style art design inspired by the Ninja Kidz.
[*] Fight multiple enemies and defeat 4 bosses in fun epic battles.
[*] Enjoy 3 game modes and challenge yourself to unlock bonus levels.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287000/NINJA_KIDZ_TIME_MASTERS/

notes.title: Ninja Kidz takes a place at Tokyo Game Show 2023 Official Steam event
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated game in US, "Ninja Kidz: Time Masters," will be featured at the official Steam event during Tokyo Game Show 2023. This exciting 2.5D action game that has captured fans' imaginations since its announcement, also it will be available to play in the form of a demo throughout the event. This presents a unique opportunity for players to get a firsthand experience of the ninja action and thrilling gameplay mechanics that Ninja Kidz offers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803124/6b13b6c5c155e5936599d9372a18c664c8d3007b.png[/img]

But that's not all. Get ready for exciting live streams of the game! During Tokyo Game Show 2023, there will live streaming sessions showcasing  gameplay. This will allow fans to delve even deeper into the world of Ninja Kidz and gain an exclusive insight into what awaits them in this epic adventure.

Train your ninja skills, and join us on this exciting journey through time at Tokyo Game Show 2023. The fun is about to begin!

notes.title: The official game of Ninja Kidz is launching this summer
notes.notes:
Last Thursday we announced announced Ninja Kidz Through Time, the official video game created by YouTube stars Ninja Kidz TV. The action-adventure game will be available this summer 2023.

With over 20 million subscribers on Youtube, Ninja Kidz TV is one of the biggest entertainment channels in the world. Ninja Kidz Through Time is an action video game inspired by beat ‘em-up classics. You will travel through time to defeat Dr. Disaster and his armies in a colourful adventure full of action and challenges to rescue the three greatest martial arts masters.

You can add it to the wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287000/NINJA_KIDZ_THROUGH_TIME/

Soon we will bring you more updates about the official game of Ninja Kidz.

- Selecta Play Team
